title: RCCL Inspector Job Performance
description:
RCCL Inspector Prometheus dashboard for one or many clusters (Alola, smci, …). Panels query nccl_* metrics from librccl-profiler-inspector.so.

Required labels: cluster, slurm_job_id, n_nodes, nranks, message_size, plus collective/algo_proto or p2p_operation. Intra-node panels use n_nodes="1" (xGMI); network panels use n_nodes!="1".

cluster comes from NCCL_INSPECTOR_CLUSTER or SLURM_CLUSTER_NAME (else unknown). Set prom_datasource, then Cluster, then Job ID. P2P rows need NCCL_INSPECTOR_ENABLE_P2P=1.
